summary: E2E testing of custom payment terms logic completed successfully. All 10 tests passed. Verified that custom and milestone_based payment terms with payment_terms_notes are correctly parsed into milestone schedules when a quotation is accepted WITHOUT negotiation. The accept_quote response includes payment_schedule field with correctly parsed milestones.
critical_code_review_comments: resolve_final_payment_terms() at line 8733 correctly returns quote's proposed_payment_terms and payment_terms_notes when no negotiations exist
generate_payment_schedule() at line 1223 correctly calls _parse_milestone_split() for both 'custom' and 'milestone_based' payment terms
_parse_milestone_split() at line 1076 correctly parses percentages from notes using regex and maps keywords to stages
accept_quote() at line 8845 correctly includes payment_schedule in response (line 8990)
Payment terms aliases (advance_100, advance_50, cod) are correctly normalized via PAYMENT_TERMS_ALIASES
seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own RFQ and quote with TEST_ prefix to avoid conflicts
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom payment terms E2E flow verified working. Full flow tested: create RFQ -> submit quote with custom/milestone terms + notes -> accept quote -> verify payment_schedule. The _parse_milestone_split() function correctly extracts percentages from payment_terms_notes and maps keywords (advance, delivery, production, inspection) to stages. Falls back to 30/40/30 when no notes provided. accept_quote response includes payment_schedule field.
